response.sql: WITH event_line_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, spent / amount as line_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL), event_avg_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(line_ratio) as event_spend_ratio FROM event_line_ratios GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(event_spend_ratio) as overall_avg FROM event_avg_ratios) SELECT ear.link_to_event as event_id, ear.event_spend_ratio as spend_ratio, ear.event_spend_ratio / oa.overall_avg as relative_ratio FROM event_avg_ratios ear CROSS JOIN overall_average oa ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
